text:
maria: Quick check — PR #8612 (microbatch allocator tweak). On my laptop I see a small p50 improvement but CI perf-run shows +8% p95. Planning to merge today if we don't have blocking regressions, can someone sanity-check the artifacts?

jon: ping @kevin @alex — I pulled the CI artifacts: https://ci.redwood/internal/8612/bench. No flamegraph yet. Is the +8% p95 noise or real?

maria: attaching the quick diff I ran locally: 
```
Benchmark: longseq-512
old: p50=12ms p95=48ms mem=820MB
new: p50=11ms p95=52ms mem=832MB
delta: p50 -8%, p95 +8%, mem +12MB
```

kevin: hmm allocs +12MB could be from changed prefill behavior. Do we have a breakdown by op?

maria: not yet, I can run a breakdown. CI perf-run has full traces (links in artifact). From quick glance the tail spiked during KV-cache refill on longseq cases.

alex: can you paste the CI run command you used? I'll re-run a focused bench on a dedicated machine.

maria: sure — this is what CI used: 
```bash
./bench/run_longseq.sh --model gpt-medium --seq 512 --iters 200 --profile=perf
```

sneh: FYI I saw a similar small tail bump in PR 8560 last month when we adjusted batch horizon. Might be compounding with this patch.

jon: I kicked off a Quick-AB run on a stable box, same load as CI but with --no-prefill to isolate. link: https://ci.redwood/internal/8612/ab-run-1

deploy-bot: Canary run started: canary-8612-2026-03-17 (3 nodes). Status: running.

alex: I ran the local focused bench. Results look closer to Maria's local numbers but still see p95 variance across seeds. Will upload logs in ~15m.

maria: thanks. If the focused runs don't reproduce CI tail, my plan is to add a short smoke guard in the rollout (hold on p95 + >5% across canaries) and land the PR behind that.

kevin: +1 for the rollout guard. Also add a small alloc telemetry tag so we can correlate mem bump to the allocator path.

jon: I'll give an LGTM once the canary completes and traces look stable. If canary shows persistent p95 bump, hold and we'll revert.

maria: noted — adding telemetry and the smoke guard now. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

alex: looking at one of the CI traces, tail seems to cluster when sequence >400 and when kv_shard_count == 3. Might be worth adding a targeted microbench for that combination.

maria: good catch — adding microbench for seq 512 + shard=3. Will paste results here when done.

sneh: thanks for coordinating — ping if you want another pair of eyes on the trace.

maria: will do. last update: canary finished, two nodes ok, one node had a transient spike but traced to noisy co-located workload. keeping the guard but proceeding with merge window if no further regressions.

jon: LGTM (pending final artifact upload).

maria: uploaded final artifacts: https://ci.redwood/internal/8612/final-artifacts. merging in 30m unless anyone raises a blocker.

kevin: no blockers from infra.

alex: no blockers from bench side.

maria: merging now. thanks all :)
